mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_experiment_record (animal_cage_id, author_id, author_name, content, images_json, status, submitted_at) VALUES (#{animalCageId}, #{authorId}, #{authorName}, #{content}, #{imagesJson}, #{status}, #{submittedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cage_experiment_record WHERE animal_cage_id = #{animalCageId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED' ORDER BY submitted_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM cage_experiment_record WHERE author_id IN #{aid} ORDER BY animal_cage_id, submitted_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM cage_experiment_record WHERE animal_cage_id = #{animalCageId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND author_id IN #{aid} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE cage_experiment_record SET content = #{content}, images_json = #{imagesJson}, status = 'SUBMITTED', submitted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
UPDATE cage_experiment_record SET status = 'ARCHIVED', archived_at = NOW() WHERE animal_cage_id = #{animalCageId} AND status != 'ARCHIVED'
